failures.source: Our Humakti god-talkers carefully marked out an area for the fight, and with \x01@\x06 watching, \x01@\x13 and \x01@\r entered from opposite sides. Suddenly, \x01@\x13 let out a piercing shriek, and ran
failures.translation: 我们的胡马科特信徒神语者为决斗仔细划出一片场地；在\x01@\x06的注视下，\x01@\x13和\x01@\r从相对两侧入场。突然，\x01@\x13发出一声刺耳尖叫，然后跑了

failures.source: One of our \x02\x03Uroxi/Humakti/Elmali\x02 thanes killed the creature before it could get away, but \x01@\x03 is dying and the god-talkers say no healing spells or resurrection can save \x08. Even as the healers consult their lore, \x01@\x03 dies.
failures.translation: 我们的一位\x02\x03乌罗克西/胡马科特信徒/埃尔马尔信徒\x02贵族在它逃走前杀死了那怪物，但\x01@\x03奄奄一息，神语者说任何治疗法术或复活都救不了\x08。就在医者查阅典籍时，\x01@\x03死去。
